blocks.text: These are jawless fishes. Lampreys and hagfish are common examples. Their bodies are eel-like and not covered with scales. They possess cartilaginous skeleton. Like other fishes, they have a single-circuit heart with one atrium and one ventricle. Fertilization is external.
